source_title: 내가 징기로 골드 버는 법 공유함
subtitle: 징기의 부특 읍소 루팅으로 던전당 10골드 — 양심(?) 골드 파밍 상황극

cuts.dialogue:

힐템으로 써도
될까요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot from behind the mooncloth cowl and pointed ears of the Night Elf Priest in foreground-right. Looking toward the Undead Paladin girl on the left (ragged cowl, grey skin, gold eyes, black-and-gold plate armor) who is kneeling on one knee, clasping her hands beneath her chin with enormous shimmering puppy-dog anime eyes and waterfall tears, pleading desperately for the dropped healer cloth gear hovering on a stone pedestal. Holy hammer sheathed at her hip. Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.
